_about: The folders copied into the screenshot simulator's Documents, as the reader's own folders on Home. Each maps a folder name (as Home shows it) to books in the sample library (marketing/sample-library, not committed). Only books that may be shown: see README.md, 'Which books may be shown'. Home lists folders newest first, so they are connected last to first: the first here is shown at the top. An entry may be [book, name]: the copy is given that name (a PDF's file name is the title shown under its cover), or [book, name, title]: a PDF copy is also given that title, which the reader's bar shows.
